messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

message.content:
Here are some widely‑available documentaries you can watch online:

| Title | Release year | Synopsis |
|-------|--------------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former U.S. Vice President Al Gore presents evidence that climate change threatens our planet’s future. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A follow‑up film showing progress—and setbacks—since the first release. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2019 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to investigate how human activity is affecting ecosystems. |
| **“Climate Change – The Facts”** | 2020 | An animated overview explaining what scientists know about greenhouse gases, sea‑level rise, and mitigation strategies. |
| **“Our Planet” (Season 1)** | 2019 | While primarily focused on biodiversity, each episode highlights how species are affected by rising temperatures and changing habitats. |

### Where to Watch

* **Netflix:** “An Inconvenient Truth,” “Before the Flood.”  
* **Amazon Prime Video / iTunes / Google Play Movies:** “An Inconvenient Sequel,” “Climate Change – The Facts.”  
* **Disney+ Hotstar / Hulu:** “Our Planet.”  

If you'd prefer something more academic or regionally specific, let me know!
